hero.title: Bachelor and Master in Hospitality Management in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: For students interested in hotel operations, tourism, resort management, food and beverage services and event planning, Mauritius is a destination to consider. Its hospitality-related programs are able to teach students practical service skills and knowledge of business management. Studying Hospitality Management in Mauritius can help students explore undergraduate and postgraduate opportunities in the hospitality and tourism sector.

## Admissions Process
Choose a course: Choose a bachelor’s or master’s program according to your qualifications and career plans.
Compare schools: View curriculum, duration and study mode, entry requirements and tuition fees.
Get your application ready: Gather academic transcripts, identification, and any necessary proof of English language proficiency.
Apply to the university: Complete the official application and submit the required documentation and fees.
Receive the admission decision Follow the university’s instructions to accept your place and pay any deposit.
Travel & Accommodation Arrangements: Once you have been admitted, you will complete the relevant student immigration formalities and organize your stay in Mauritius.
Students applying for Hospitality Management admission in Mauritius should follow the official application process and check the latest deadlines and documentation requirements.
## Further study opportunities
After obtaining a hospitality management bachelor’s degree, students may consider:
MSc in Tourism and Hospitality Management.
Master in Tourism Management.
MBA with hospitality or service-management concentration, if available.
Post-Graduate in Event Management.
Business Management MBA.
Postgraduate qualifications in hotel operations, tourism planning or sustainable tourism.
With a relevant master’s degree, graduates can go on to research degrees such as an MPhil or PhD, provided they meet the university admission requirements.
Students completing a Bachelor's in Hospitality Management in Mauritius may explore these postgraduate pathways according to their academic background and the admission criteria of the institution.
## Job Openings
Graduates in Hospitality Management can find opportunities in hotels, resorts, restaurants, travel companies, event businesses and tourism related organizations.
Possible careers are:
Operations Executive (Hotel)
Front Office Supervisor
Guest Relations Executive
Food and Beverage Supervisor \-
Supervisor, Restaurant
Housekeeping In-charge, Resort Operations In-charge, Event Management Officer, Tourism Operations Officer
Sales & Marketing Hospitality, Executive
Assistant Revenue Manager
Hotel / Resort Manager with relevant experience

Work experience, communication skills, customer service ability and knowledge of hospitality software can improve career possibilities. Work opportunities and work permit eligibility differ by country and employer.
## Required Documents
The exact checklist varies from university to university, but applicants may be required to submit:
Good passport.
High school diplomas and undergraduate transcripts for admission.
Bachelor degree certificate and transcripts for masters admission.
English language test results, where applicable.
Updated CV or resume where requested.
Statement of purpose / Letter of motivation (if applicable)
Passport size photo(s).
College application form completed.
Proof of payment of the application fee, if applicable.
Additional documents requested by the admissions office.
Documentation of student visa or residence-permit at the proper stage.
Make sure you keep copies of all your scanned documents, and also provide certified translations if required by the university.
## FAQ’s
### 1\. Can I pursue Hospitality Management in Mauritius after Class 12?

Yes . If you have completed secondary education and meet the entry requirements of the institution, you can apply for an undergraduate program in hospitality. University of Mauritius BSc (Hons) Tourism, Hospitality and Events Management. Students can consider a Bachelor's in Hospitality Management in Mauritius after Class 12 if they meet the required criteria.
### 2\. How long is a Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality Management in Mauritius?

The University of Mauritius offers a full-time 3.5 year BSc (Hons) Tourism, Hospitality and Events Management program. The Open University of Mauritius lists its BSc (Hons) Hotel Management and Catering Technologies as a four-to-six year program.
### 3\. Is there a Masters in Hospitality Management in Mauritius?

Yup. The University of Mauritius is offering an MSc Tourism and Hospitality Management program of two years part-time duration for the academic year 2026-2027. This is an option for students interested in a Master's in Hospitality Management in Mauritius.
### 4\. What is the tuition fee of Hospitality Management in Mauritius?

Fees vary by institution and by type of student. The tuition fee for international non-SADC students for the BSc (Hons) Hotel Management and Catering Technologies at The Open University of Mauritius is US\$5,750. Candidates are advised to check the latest fee before applying.
### 5\. What jobs can I get after studying Hospitality Management in Mauritius ?

Graduates may find work in hotel operations, front office services, food and beverage management, resort administration, event planning, tourism operations, hospitality marketing, and other areas. Career advancement is based on your qualifications, experience, skills, and your eligibility to work.

Choosing Hospitality Management in Mauritius can help students build academic knowledge and practical skills for the hospitality and tourism industry. Before applying, compare the available Hospitality Management courses in Mauritius, check university requirements and confirm the latest tuition fees.
